runtime_scope: README states #1714 CN bring-up flags, #1693 staging arena, and follow-on distributed exchange runtime are prerequisites. UUID-only MIG_DEVICES is explicitly unsupported on the current engine because its NVML device-count check fails; use GPU_DEVICES=0,1 on that box until fixed. Each CN uses GPU_MEM plus STAGING outside that limit plus CUDA context overhead.
